title: LEGALΔ: ENHANCING LEGAL REASONING IN LLMS VIA REINFORCEMENT LEARNING WITH CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT GUIDED INFORMATION GAIN
reasoning: The paper focuses on legal reasoning and judgment prediction in the context of legal AI systems. It evaluates performance on legal benchmarks like CAIL2018 and JEC-QA, focusing on accuracy and decision reliability rather than religion, spiritual traditions, or general ethical/moral reasoning frameworks.
